comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The target offers six post-propaedeutic tracks after a common first year. Nederlands Recht is the least specialized route: it continues private, criminal, constitutional and administrative law and adds European and public international law, legal philosophy or sociology, and an integrated student courtroom. This selection follows the target structure and official presentation rather than UCR fit.

Both examine EU institutions, the EU legal order and the internal market.

notes.text: Groningen teaches Dutch law through a sequence in civil, criminal, constitutional and administrative law, with dedicated legal research and a courtroom capstone.
